international.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
international.summary: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public. It is not known if the incidents are linked.

international.title: US Coast Guard suspends search for woman swept out to sea in California
international.summary: Senah Park, 24, was last seen near Panther state beach on Sunday evening amid historic high tides and water levels The US Coast Guard announced that it has suspended its search for a 24-year-old woman who is believed to have been swept out to sea in California . The woman, identified as 24-year-old Senah Park, was last seen near Panther state beach in Santa Cruz county at about 8.30pm local time on Sunday, authorities said earlier this week.
